customers.description: One record per synthetic customer. Demographic/risk attributes only -- no names, addresses, or other sensitive PII.

created_at.description: Date the customer record was created.

credit_score_band.description: Coarse credit score bracket, statistically correlated with risk_segment.

risk_segment.description: Underwriting risk tier. Drives interest rate range and loan/payment outcome probabilities during generation.

loans.description: One record per loan. Every loan references an existing customer_id.

principal_amount.description: Original loan principal, in dollars. Always positive.

interest_rate.description: Descriptive metadata only. NOT used in scheduled_payment_amount or any balance calculation in the MVP.

loan_status.description: ACTIVE: still within its term. CLOSED: term elapsed, PAID payments reconcile to principal within $0.01. DEFAULTED: payment history ends in a LATE/MISSED payment; no further payments generated.

scheduled_payment_amount.description: principal_amount / term_months, rounded to 2 decimals. This is also amount_due on every payment for this loan.

payments.description: One record per due date. Every payment references an existing loan_id.

payment_date.description: Date the payment was actually made. Null for SCHEDULED and MISSED payments.

amount_due.description: Always equal to the parent loan's scheduled_payment_amount.

amount_paid.description: Amount actually paid. > 0 for PAID and LATE; == 0 for SCHEDULED, MISSED, and FAILED.

payment_status.description: PAID: on/before due_date, amount_paid > 0 -- counted as successful in the MVP balance calculation. LATE: after due_date, amount_paid > 0 -- money was eventually received, but excluded from the MVP balance calculation as a deliberate simplification (see context/business_rules.json). MISSED: never paid, amount_paid == 0. FAILED: an attempted payment that did not succeed, amount_paid == 0. SCHEDULED: not yet due, amount_paid == 0.

payment_method.description: How the payment was made or attempted.

portfolio_summary.description: Single aggregate object (not an array) produced by src/legacy/transform.py from loans.json and payments.json.

as_of_date.description: The business date this summary represents.

successful_payment_count.description: Number of payments with payment_status in business_rules.successful_payment_statuses (PAID only, for the MVP).

total_original_principal.description: Sum of principal_amount across all loans.

total_successful_payments.description: Sum of amount_paid across successful payments only.

total_outstanding_balance.description: total_original_principal - total_successful_payments. Answers 'what is today's total outstanding loan balance?'

_lifecycle_model_note: Entries below (lifecycle_*) describe the 12-table full-lifecycle model produced by src/generate_data.py into data/lifecycle/raw/ -- campaign -> email engagement -> offer -> application -> underwriting decision -> funded loan -> payment schedule -> payment events -> delinquency/default. This is SEPARATE from and does not replace the entries above (customers/loans/payments/portfolio_summary), which describe the original 3-scenario model in data/raw/ and data/processed/ and remain completely unmodified. lifecycle_customers and lifecycle_loans are prefixed because their schemas differ slightly from the entries above (lifecycle_customers adds credit_score; lifecycle_loans adds application_id) -- same table concept, evolved shape.

lifecycle_customers.description: One record per synthetic customer -- same concept as customers above, plus a raw numeric credit_score alongside the existing band.

created_at.description: Date the customer record was created.

credit_score_band.description: Coarse credit score bracket, statistically correlated with risk_segment.

credit_score.description: Raw FICO-style score (300-850), consistent with credit_score_band. Kept alongside the band specifically so a schema-drift scenario (e.g. this field silently changing from int to string) has a real value to corrupt.

risk_segment.description: Underwriting risk tier. Drives interest rate range and loan/payment outcome probabilities during generation.

target_risk_segment.description: Intended target risk segment, informational only -- not enforced against who actually engaged.

lifecycle_coupon_rules.description: Discount rules attached to campaigns. coupon_code is DELIBERATELY not unique across rows -- the same code string can be reissued across separate campaigns/rows, the way marketing teams reuse code names. coupon_rule_id is the real primary key, not coupon_code.

coupon_rule_id.description: Unique coupon rule identifier, format CPN00001.

coupon_code.description: Redemption code shown to customers. Not unique -- see table description.

discount_value.description: Discount magnitude: an APR reduction for RATE_DISCOUNT, a dollar amount for FEE_WAIVER.

lifecycle_email_events.description: SENT -> OPENED -> CLICKED funnel events, one row per event per (customer, campaign).

event_type.description: Funnel stage. A given (customer, campaign) can have at most one of each, in this order.

lifecycle_prequal_offers.description: Pre-qualified offers, either following a CLICKED email event or organic (no campaign).

campaign_id.description: Foreign key into campaigns.campaign_id, or null for an organic (non-campaign) offer.

coupon_code.description: Redemption reference, if any. NOT a foreign key to coupon_rules.coupon_rule_id -- it's the raw code string a customer would enter, and coupon_code is not unique (see lifecycle_coupon_rules).

expires_at.description: Offer expiration date, informational only -- not enforced against application eligibility.

lifecycle_applications.description: Loan applications, either following an offer or organic (applied with no prior offer).

offer_id.description: Foreign key into prequal_offers.offer_id, or null for an organic application.

application_status.description: DECISIONED: an underwriting_decisions row exists for this application. WITHDRAWN/SUBMITTED: no decision was made -- WITHDRAWN means the customer pulled out, SUBMITTED means it's still pending as of as_of_date.

decision.description: Underwriting outcome. Only APPROVED decisions can lead to a funded loan (and not all do -- see lifecycle_loans).

rejection_reason.description: Set only when decision is REJECTED.

approved_amount.description: Set only when decision is APPROVED.

approved_apr.description: Set only when decision is APPROVED.

model_version.description: Which underwriting model version made this decision (e.g. uw-model-v1, uw-model-v2), deterministic from decided_at relative to a fixed cutover date -- not random.

lifecycle_loans.description: Funded loans -- same concept as loans above, plus application_id. One loan per APPROVED decision that actually funds (not all approved decisions fund). loan_status is derived from elapsed time since origination relative to term_months, not assigned independently.

principal_amount.description: Original loan principal, in dollars. Always positive.

interest_rate.description: Used in the lifecycle model's accrued-interest metric (unlike the original loans table, where it is descriptive-only).

originated_at.description: Date the loan was originated -- always after the parent decision's decided_at.

loan_status.description: ACTIVE: still within its term. CLOSED: term elapsed, PAID events reconcile to principal within $0.01. DEFAULTED: payment history ends in a LATE/MISSED event.

lifecycle_payment_schedule.description: Every loan's full set of expected installments -- what SHOULD happen, independent of what actually did (see lifecycle_payment_events for that).

schedule_id.description: Unique schedule entry identifier, format SCH00000001.

scheduled_amount.description: Equal to the parent loan's scheduled_payment_amount.

lifecycle_payment_events.description: What actually happened per installment -- only realized outcomes are recorded here (a future-dated installment with nothing realized yet simply has no row). Also carries occasional REVERSAL events offsetting an earlier PAID event.

schedule_id.description: Foreign key into payment_schedule.schedule_id. Always set in practice for this generator, but nullable in principle.

event_type.description: REVERSAL rows always have payment_status REVERSED and a negative amount.

payment_date.description: Date the payment (or reversal) actually occurred. Null for MISSED. Never after as_of_date.

amount.description: Positive for PAID/LATE, 0 for MISSED/FAILED, negative for REVERSAL (offsetting the original PAID amount).

payment_status.description: Same semantics as the original payments table's payment_status for PAID/LATE/MISSED/FAILED. REVERSED is new -- see event_type.

payment_method.description: How the payment was made or attempted.

lifecycle_delinquency_events.description: A snapshot row for any loan with at least one LATE/MISSED payment event.

as_of_date.description: The business date this snapshot represents.

days_past_due.description: Days past due, consistent with bucket.

bucket.description: CURRENT is defined in the enum but never generated by src/generate_data.py -- a delinquency_events row existing at all means the loan is, by construction, in one of the other three buckets.

loan_id.description: Foreign key into loans.loan_id. At most one default row per loan.

balance_at_default.description: principal_amount minus successful payments made before default, floored at 0.

recovery_amount.description: Amount recovered after default, if any. 0 when recovery_date is null.
